caption: The drawing depicts a geometric, symmetrical composition resembling a textile or rug pattern, composed of small, roughly circular brushstrokes. The central design consists of a vertically-oriented, stepped motif with alternating bands of color that include various shades of green, blue, purple, brown, and some vertical accents in red, orange, yellow, and pink. The stepped edges of the central geometric shape are outlined in alternating white and red. The background area outside the central motif is filled with small tan and light brown circular strokes. The drawing is enclosed in a thin black rectangular border and is signed "Ruth M. Bairnes" in the bottom right corner, with the annotation "A 2115.2.13." in the bottom left corner.
title: Hooked Rug - Center Design
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
